ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: The figure below is a schematic diagram of the Ural River water system, and 1, 2, and 3 are three hydrological observation stations. Read the figure and answer the following questions. <image1> What is the main source of supply water for the Ural River?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a schematic diagram of the Ural River water system, marking three hydrological observation stations, 1, 2, and 3; the monthly runoff distribution chart of “annual distribution of runoff” in the lower right shows that the runoff of the Ural River has an obvious concentrated peak in the spring months, while the runoff in other months of the year is relatively small. Then reason: If a river has a concentrated flood peak in spring, it usually corresponds to a large amount of winter snow melting and supplying the river after temperatures rise in spring; if rainwater supply is the main source, the runoff peak generally corresponds to the rainy season and would not show this typical spring snowmelt peak. Therefore, the main source of supply water for the Ural River is seasonal snowmelt water.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：右下角的月径流分配图显示乌拉尔河径流在春季月份突然达到全年最高，其他月份流量较小。再结合题干问“补给水源主要是什么”，用水文判读规则：春季集中性洪峰对应冬季积雪融化，而不是雨水或冰川长期融水。因此回答为季节性积雪融水。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中为乌拉尔河水系示意图，标出了1、2、3三个水文观测站；右下角的“径流量年内分配”月径流分配图显示，乌拉尔河径流在春季月份出现明显集中高峰，全年其他月份径流量相对较小。再推理：河流若在春季出现集中性洪峰，通常对应冬季积雪在春季气温回升后大量融化补给河流；如果以雨水补给为主，径流高峰一般与雨季对应，不会表现为这种典型春季融雪峰。因此，乌拉尔河的主要补给水源是季节性积雪融水。
